name: Yakusoku
source:
Sayama Yuichi is a college student who is being followed by misfortune. He lost his parents and memory in an accident. However, his life changes completely with the appearance of several girls in his life. Time has come to fulfill the old "promise" given before memory loss. But what was that promise? 

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
佐山雄一是一名厄运缠身的大学生。一场事故夺走了他的父母，也让他失去记忆。然而，几名少女相继出现在生活中，彻底改变了他的人生。如今，兑现失忆前那份古老“约定”的时刻终于到来。可是，约定的内容究竟是什么？

[根据 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vndb-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]修改]
